metaDescription: Order custom folding golf divot tools for your next event. Bulk pricing, fast turnaround. Perfect for corporate golf outings.
introHtml: Folding golf divot tools offer a compact solution for golfers who prefer to carry their repair tool in a pocket or golf bag without bulk. The folding design protects the prongs when not in use and makes the tool easy to access with one hand. For corporate golf tournaments or employee appreciation gifts, custom imprinting on the flat surface of a folding divot tool provides a clean, visible logo that stands out on the green. Choose from metal or plastic models depending on your budget and desired feel.
heroAltText: Custom folding golf divot tools with imprinted logo, compact design for easy carrying
